meta.title: DSH tools
meta.description: Eight utilities: 1) a More menu in the Windows caption bar offering Reload plugins (hot-reload installed plugin code without interrupting sessions) and Restart DSH (⚠ one click restarts immediately; running tasks are interrupted); 2) a Generate button in the composer that drafts an intended reply from the last assistant message; 3) an Optimize button that rewrites the prompt in the composer into a version the AI understands and executes more easily (the composer locks while generating/optimizing and unlocks when done); 4) terminal-style input history — ArrowUp/ArrowDown in the composer cycles through the messages you sent this session; 5) a Source Control entry in the right "Start" toolbar — a VSCode-style panel: scans only the current workspace (follows session switches automatically), browse git changes grouped by repository (groups start collapsed, click to expand), view per-file diffs (toggle side-by-side / unified, preference remembered), commit a checked subset of files as one commit, generate the commit message with AI following each repo's history style, then push; the panel's header row beside the refresh button and each group header also offer Update code (git pull --rebase --autostash) and Update database (pnpm prisma:generate → prisma:push) buttons, acting on one repo or batched across all; per-repo updates run through an embedded terminal-style process console — live output streaming, stdin input while running, one-click kill, one-click accept-data-loss retry for Prisma and abort-and-reset for rebase conflicts; 6) a quick-phrases bar inside the composer card right above the input — click a phrase to insert it at the caret, up to five shown, editable in Tools settings; 7) a Today chip at the bottom of the sidebar — the day's token usage at a glance (input/output/cache read/cache write, request count), click for buckets and a 7-day trend; 8) Settings → Tools: toggle each feature independently, edit quick phrases, pick a faster custom model for generate/optimize, and manage Source Control scan roots. The titlebar button is desktop-only.
